title: FlowMoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning with Conjugate-Gradient Data Consistency for Highly Accelerated 4D Flow MRI Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2608.25828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present FlowMoDL, an unrolled neural network for highly accelerated 4D flow MRI reconstruction that directly optimizes for both anatomical magnitude and phase-derived velocity accuracy. Building on the MoDL framework, FlowMoDL alternates a learned (3+1)D spatiotemporal denoiser with conjugate-gradient data-consistency updates based on the SENSE forward model. A novel dual-pathway conditioning scheme adapts the denoiser features and data-consistency weighting, enabling a single model to handle varying acceleration factors ($10\times$ to $50\times$). To ensure physiological accuracy, the network is trained using a deep-supervision composite loss that explicitly penalizes velocity magnitude and angular errors, stabilized by a curriculum schedule. translated_title: FlowMoDL：基于模型的深度学习与共轭梯度数据一致性用于高度加速4D血流MRI重建
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FlowMoDL，一种用于高度加速4D血流MRI重建的展开神经网络，它直接优化解剖幅度和相位导出的速度精度。基于MoDL框架，FlowMoDL交替使用学习的(3+1)D时空去噪器与基于SENSE前向模型的共轭梯度数据一致性更新。一种新颖的双路径条件化方案自适应去噪器特征和数据一致性权重，使单一模型能够处理不同的加速因子（$10\times$至$50\times$）。为确保生理准确性，网络使用深度监督复合损失进行训练，该损失显式惩罚速度幅度和角度误差，并通过课程调度进行稳定。我们在多中心CMRx4DFlow数据集上评估了FlowMoDL，并与经典和深度学习基线（CG-SENSE、MoDL、FlowVN和FlowMRI-Net）进行比较。FlowMoDL的一个关键优势是其优越性。
tldr: FlowMoDL通过双路径条件化和深度监督复合损失，实现了高度加速4D血流MRI重建中速度和幅度的同时优化，优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: FlowMoDL achieves superior 4D flow MRI reconstruction by jointly optimizing velocity and magnitude via dual-path conditioning and deep-supervised composite loss, outperforming existing baselines.
